description: Defines a data transfer object (DTO) class LicenseSearchFilterParams used for filtering license search results within the OrangeHRM application. The class extends a base FilterParams class, sets a default sort field, and restricts sorting to specific fields.

classes.name: LicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters for licenses, including allowed sorting fields and default sorting configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a default sort field 'l.name'.
